demo_disclaimer: All premiums shown are fictional indicative rates for the SalesPilot demo and do not represent actual insurance quotations. Final premiums are subject to age, underwriting, plan selection and insurer assessment.

products.name: CareSure Essential
products.positioning: Affordable entry-level health protection for essential hospital and medical needs (Public Hospital B1).
products.target_customer: Singapore-based individuals, especially young professionals and first-time insurance buyers.
products.eligibility: Singapore Citizens, PRs and eligible residents aged 18-60; subject to underwriting.
products.coverage: Public hospital B1-level coverage; inpatient hospitalisation, selected outpatient treatments, specialist treatment and emergency treatment.
products.premium: From S$600/year (indicative demo price, subject to age and underwriting).
products.deductible: S$1,500 deductible + 5% co-payment on eligible claims.
products.limits: Annual claim limit up to S$100,000.
products.waiting_period: 30 days for general illnesses; accident-related treatment subject to policy terms.
products.exclusions: Pre-existing conditions unless specifically accepted; cosmetic procedures; non-medically necessary and experimental treatment; treatment outside policy scope.
products.claims: Customer submits a claim through CareSure; the insurer reviews supporting medical documents and pays the approved amount per policy terms.
products.payment: Annual premium; eligible components may be payable through MediSave subject to prevailing limits, with excess payable in cash.
products.renewal: Annual renewal; premium and policy terms may be revised at renewal.

faq.q: Can I use it for private hospitals?
faq.a: Essential is designed around B1-level public-hospital coverage; private-hospital treatment may have limited reimbursement depending on policy terms.

products.name: CareSure Family
products.positioning: Family-oriented health protection (2-6 members) with shared administration and family pricing benefits, Public Hospital B1/A options.
products.target_customer: Families with 2-6 members, including couples with children and multi-member households.
products.eligibility: Family members aged 18-65 as primary insured; children/dependants may be added subject to plan rules and underwriting.
products.coverage: B1/A-level public-hospital options; inpatient hospitalisation, selected outpatient treatment, specialist treatment and emergency care.
products.premium: From S$1,800/family/year for a standard family configuration; final premium depends on family composition and underwriting.
products.deductible: S$1,500 deductible per person + 5% co-payment on eligible claims.
products.limits: Annual claim limit up to S$150,000 per person per year.
products.waiting_period: 30 days for general illnesses; accident-related treatment subject to policy terms.
products.exclusions: Pre-existing conditions unless accepted; cosmetic, non-medically necessary and experimental treatment; conditions excluded in the individual policy.
products.claims: Claims are submitted through CareSure; supporting medical documents are reviewed per insured member and approved amounts reimbursed per policy terms.
products.payment: Annual family premium; eligible components may be payable through MediSave subject to prevailing rules and limits.
products.renewal: Annual renewal; each insured member remains subject to applicable renewal terms.

faq.q: Can I cover my spouse and children?
faq.a: Yes. Eligible family members can be included subject to the plan's age, dependency and underwriting requirements.

products.name: CareSure Plus
products.positioning: Enhanced health protection for customers who want higher coverage limits, broader healthcare options and private-hospital access.
products.target_customer: Individuals and families seeking broader coverage and greater flexibility, including access to higher-tier healthcare.
products.eligibility: Singapore Citizens, PRs and eligible residents aged 18-65; subject to medical underwriting.
products.coverage: Private / higher-tier hospital coverage; inpatient care, specialist treatment, selected outpatient treatments, emergency care and selected preventive benefits.
products.premium: From S$1,500/year per adult (indicative demo price, subject to age, coverage selection and underwriting).
products.deductible: S$2,500 deductible + 5% co-payment on eligible claims.
products.limits: Annual claim limit up to S$500,000 per person per year.
products.waiting_period: 30 days for general illnesses; selected benefits may have different waiting periods.
products.exclusions: Pre-existing conditions unless accepted; cosmetic, experimental and non-medically necessary treatment; medical conditions or treatments stated as excluded in the policy.
products.claims: Customer or medical provider submits claim documents; CareSure assesses eligibility and reimburses approved claims according to policy terms.
products.payment: Annual premium; eligible premium components may be payable through MediSave within prevailing withdrawal limits; excess paid in cash.
products.renewal: Annual renewal; premiums and policy conditions may be revised at renewal.

faq.q: Does Plus guarantee coverage for my existing medical condition?
faq.a: No. Pre-existing conditions are subject to underwriting and may be covered, excluded or subject to other terms.

products.name: CareSure Corporate
products.positioning: Group health insurance for Singapore SMEs (10-500 employees) with centralised administration.
products.target_customer: Singapore-registered businesses with 10-500 eligible employees; employees/dependants subject to corporate policy terms.
products.eligibility: Singapore-registered businesses with 10-500 eligible employees; employees/dependants subject to corporate policy terms.
products.coverage: Group inpatient hospitalisation, outpatient treatment, specialist treatment, emergency care; optional higher-tier/private healthcare benefits.
products.premium: From S$600/employee/year; final quotation depends on workforce size, age profile, coverage level and underwriting.
products.deductible: S$1,500 deductible per employee + 5% co-payment for eligible claims; corporate plan may define different employee benefit tiers.
products.limits: Up to S$100,000 per employee per year for standard inpatient coverage.
products.waiting_period: 30 days for new eligible employees, subject to group policy terms.
products.exclusions: Pre-existing conditions subject to group underwriting terms; cosmetic, non-medically necessary and experimental treatment; activities/treatments excluded in the corporate policy.
products.claims: Employee submits a claim through the CareSure portal/app or approved medical provider; CareSure processes the claim and notifies employee/employer per policy rules.
products.payment: Employer pays annual/group premium; payment can be monthly or annually depending on the corporate agreement.
products.renewal: Annual corporate renewal; premium may be adjusted based on workforce profile, claims experience and selected coverage.

faq.q: We have 120 employees. Can you provide a quotation?
faq.a: Yes. SalesPilot can identify your company size and requirements, then connect you with a CareSure corporate sales representative for a quotation.
